android-feedback|Inline message.summary: A Plenix inline message on Android is a Material 3 Surface built as the Plenix notice: the tone’s soft fill with a 1 dp edge in the tone’s border color, 4 dp corners, the tone’s icon and DM Sans text in the tone’s content color. As a section message it adds a semibold title, one or two outlined buttons and a close icon button at a 48 dp target. A danger message is a live region (TalkBack reads it when it appears); a retry shows the wait and the attempt under the text in the data font. Material 3 has no inline message component; Plenix composes one from its parts.

compose: fun PlenixNotice(tone: Tone, text: String, title: String? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, actions: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}) {
modifier = Modifier.semantics { if (tone == Tone.Danger) liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Assertive }
title?.let { Text(it, color = content, fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textLabelSize) }
Text(text, color = content, fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textSecondarySize)
onDismiss?.let { IconButton(onClick = it) { Icon(Icons.Outlined.Close, contentDescription = "Dismiss", tint = content) } }
views: <!-- res/layout/plenix_notice.xml: the soft fill and edge come from PlenixNoticeView (MaterialShapeDrawable) -->
